description_en: Retrieves the URL of a stream
name: DescribeStreamURL

parameters.help_en:
The type of the stream. The default value is \`live\`. Valid values:

\`live\`: a live stream.

\`vod\`: a video-on-demand (VOD) stream, such as a historical stream from a Network Video Recorder (NVR)
parameters.help_zh:
流类型，默认live。取值：
live（直播流）
vod（点播流，例如NVR上的历史流）
parameters.name: type

parameters.help_en:
The playback protocol for the stream. Valid values:

rtmp

flv

hls
parameters.help_zh:
流播放协议。取值：
rtmp
flv
hls
parameters.name: out_protocol

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to generate a signed URL. Valid values:

true

false
parameters.help_zh:
是否需要生成签名URL。取值：
true
false
parameters.name: auth

parameters.help_en:
The primary key associated with the playback domain name. This key is used to generate the authentication URL.

Call the DescribeVsDomainConfigs (https://next.api.aliyun.com/document/vs/2018-12-12/DescribeVsDomainConfigs) operation to query the \`AuthKey\` information
parameters.help_zh:
播放域名关联的主key，用于生成鉴权URL。

通过 DescribeVsDomainConfigs (https://next.api.aliyun.com/document/vs/2018-12-12/DescribeVsDomainConfigs) 接口查询对应的AuthKey信息
parameters.name: auth_key

parameters.help_en: The time-to-live (TTL) of the URL. Unit: seconds
parameters.name: expire

parameters.help_en:
The start time. This parameter applies to \`vod\` streams.
A UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds.
parameters.help_zh:
开始时间，适用于vod流类型。  
unix时间戳，单位：秒
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en:
The end time. This parameter applies to \`vod\` streams.
A UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds.
parameters.help_zh:
结束时间，适用于vod流类型。  
unix时间戳，单位：秒
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The name of the transcoding rule. This parameter is valid only after a transcoding template is attached
parameters.help_zh: 转码规则名称（需要先绑定转码模板）
parameters.name: transcode

ExpireTime.description_en:
The time when the URL expires.
A UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds.
ExpireTime.description_zh:
URL过期时间点。  
unix时间戳，单位：秒
